questions.question: The manager, who was absent from the meeting yesterday, had been informed about the new policy.
options: had been informed
was informed
had informed
is being informed

questions.question: Unless I pass this exam, I won't be able to graduate on time.
options: If I don't pass the exam, I will graduate late
I'll fail if I don't pass the exam
Unless I pass the exam, I won't graduate
I won't graduate unless I pass the exam
questions.answer: Unless I pass the exam, I won't be able to graduate on time

questions.question: It is essential that the company's financial reports are submitted to the board by the end of the month.
options: The company's financial reports should be submitted
The financial reports must be submitted by the end of the month
It is necessary for the financial reports to be submitted
The company's financial reports need to be submitted
questions.answer: It is essential that the company's financial reports are submitted to the board by the end of the month

questions.question: By the time I arrived, they had already eaten dinner.
options: They had eaten dinner when I arrived
I ate dinner before they did
When I arrived, they were eating dinner
It was late by the time I arrived
questions.answer: By the time I arrived, they had already eaten dinner

questions.question: The new policy will only be implemented if it is approved by the government.
options: If the policy is not approved, it won't be implemented
The policy will be implemented regardless of government approval
The government's approval is required for the policy to be implemented
Unless the policy is approved, it will never be implemented
questions.answer: The new policy will only be implemented if it is approved by the government
